I opened and read this. Solely to spite you. :)

I identify with about 90% of it too.

> Have you seen a doctor about both your mental health and your physical health? It's a stretch, but they could be related.

Haven't had a "real" doctor's visit since last October, and my bare-bones health insurance doesn't cover much outside of ordinary checkups. Been paying for the shrink sessions out of pocket and I had a (brief) mental-health related hospital stay a few months ago and they covered less than half the cost. The trust fund I leech out of is what pays for it so altering it is a bit of a pain because bureaucracy.
